Inertial physical.bin plus z/vz/uz-only accelerating frame.bin. Soil initial33 full bits plus initial ID/coordinate files must match existing CPU private3J reader; fixed material markers are not equated. Live_final == last_poro whole bytes. No automatic Audit.
actions.Audit: Requires successful own Run and Read. Separate helper --audit constant smoke DATA DT XML -- -gpu:0 -stable -mdbc_freeslip PREFIX NEWAUDIT ... under Debug memcheck. Real 3 endpoint force evaluations; no Run/ComputeStep/physical advancement. Seal own call and artifacts, no automatic ReviewAudit.
actions.ReviewAudit: Pure PowerShell retained CSV/JSON review only. 3 endpoint rows +3072 native rate rows +6 face rows +3 original-PART hash rows. Original raw-term rate budget, actual native ownership, fixed-error/soil33 rollback, cache/current necessary-step screens and original face velocity/flux/reaction budgets retained. No independent neighborhood reconstruction is claimed for CSV rechecking.

safety.native_energy: bodyframe ratio <=1.1; inertial energy descriptive only
safety.initial_soil33: exact all bits, no signed-zero exception
safety.endpoint_rate: Original 64*FLT_EPS raw-term +256*DBL_EPS max(1,|Btheta|)+1e-6 propagated budget from frozen CPP, all reported actual/ref/error/ratio checked; no new physical tolerance.
safety.faces: Both x planes at every sample; q=-k/gamma*(Gp+rho_w*Ace), internal Ace reaction only, no extra gravity term or bodyframe reaction correction. Original vn/q/reaction budgets retained. Smoke does not require the full-window wrong-Ace nonempty gate; all reported detection counts are nevertheless recomputed.
safety.scope: Single-run necessary dt screens are not a sufficient stability theorem; endpoint force snapshots are not original integrator-stage telemetry.

owned_calls.typed_exit: Reset LASTEXITCODE=null, direct native call, capture immediately and require actual int0. Precreate empty raw log so silent readers remain sealable.
owned_calls.Debug_memcheck: Both real solver and separate endpoint audit require raw ERROR SUMMARY 0 errors and LEAK SUMMARY 0 bytes leaked in 0 allocations.
owned_calls.tool_provenance: Retained logs/upl_gpu_wall_component_Debug_r2.call.json identifies actual sanitizer executable; its historical typed-capture field is not invented. Every new call has its own explicit typed capture.
owned_calls.failure: Fresh paths only. Failure call/raw partials/check preserved. A completed actual solver is never restarted for reader/postcheck failure, nor completed audit restarted for review failure; repairs need a new offline label.

outputs.logs: Each native process has separate .call.json and .log. Raw source files and all new output files are hash-bound locally; no publication action.
